title: Deep Generative Crystal Structure Prediction: A Benchmark Study and a Controlled Test of Prototype Dependence
abstract: arXiv:2609.26502v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep generative models are widely reported to enable de novo crystal structure prediction (CSP), but their capability has not been measured consistently against template-based methods. We evaluate 12 representative generative CSP models, spanning latent-variable, diffusion, flow-matching, autoregressive, and manifold random-walk architectures, against TCSP 2.0 on 180 test structures and a leakage-controlled subset of 46. All methods use identical structure-matching, symmetry, and consensus criteria. Template retrieval is the strongest single method, reaching 68.3% top-1 success; symmetry-aware EquiCSP (66.4%) and Uni-3DAR (62.9%) form the next tier. However, comparison with TCSP 2.0 shows that most structures correctly predicted by generative models are also correctly predicted by template substitution. Thus, the set of structures uniquely reachable by generation is small, limiting its practical advantage for discovering structures out

translated_title: 深度生成式晶体结构预测：基准研究与原型依赖性的受控测试
translated_abstract: 深度生成模型被广泛报道能够实现从头晶体结构预测（CSP），但其能力尚未与基于模板的方法进行一致的衡量。我们在180个测试结构以及一个包含46个结构的数据泄漏受控子集上，评估了12个具有代表性的生成式CSP模型（涵盖潜变量、扩散、流匹配、自回归和流形随机游走等架构），并与TCSP 2.0进行对比。所有方法均采用相同的结构匹配、对称性和共识判据。模板检索是最强的单一方法，达到68.3%的top-1成功率；对称性感知的EquiCSP（66.4%）和Uni-3DAR（62.9%）构成第二梯队。然而，与TCSP 2.0的对比表明，生成模型正确预测的大多数结构同样能通过模板替换正确预测。因此，仅能通过生成方法到达的结构集合很小，这限制了其在发现新结构方面的实际优势。
tldr: 基准测试表明，深度生成式晶体结构预测模型的整体性能仍不及模板检索方法，且其能独有预测出的结构集合很小，实际发现新结构的优势有限。
en_tdlr: Benchmarking shows that deep generative crystal structure prediction models still underperform template retrieval, and the set of structures uniquely reachable by generation is small, limiting their practical advantage for discovering new structures.
